integrity: General symbolic semigroup, facet, and divisor-class proof; bounded exact checker supplements rather than certifies infinite claims. No independent external mathematical validation.
scientific_limitations: Fixed-point local rings of the complex projective crown-graph edge toric variety only; no assertion about the whole singular locus or resolutions. General toric divisor formulas are prior knowledge; equivalent unindexed specialization remains possible.
title: Local class groups and a non-\(\mathbb Q\)-Gorenstein threshold for crown-graph toric varieties
